title: Jowar Bhakri
description: A rustic, gluten-free sorghum flatbread patted by hand and roasted on the tawa, eaten with pithla, thecha or a spicy curry.
steps: Mix the jowar flour and salt in a wide plate.
Add the hot water gradually and mix with a spoon, then knead with wet hands into a smooth, soft dough.
Divide into 8 balls and pat each one into a thin round on a dusted board or between damp palms.
Place on a hot tawa, sprinkle a little water on top and cook until the underside sets, about 1 minute.
Flip and roast until light spots form, then place directly on a low flame to puff.
Serve hot, brushed with ghee if you like.
